lines.t: Verse 1
I walk beneath the autumn sky,
And watch the golden leaves go by.
The crimson trees, the fields of gold,
Tell me Your wonders never grow old.
Each fragile flower beneath my feet
Reminds me that Your love is sweet.
Though I am small beneath the sky,
You see me when I laugh or cry.
Chorus
In every leaf, I see You, Lord,
In every breeze that moves the fields.
In eagle’s wings above the clouds,
Your glory shines, Your love is real.
In every flower, every tree,
Your hand of grace is clear to me.
Wherever I may turn my eyes,
Your beauty fills the earth and skies.
Verse 2
I hear Your whisper in the grass,
A gentle voice as winds pass by.
The sunlight dances on the streams,
And paints the world with golden beams.
The leaves may fall, the flowers fade,
But You remain, unchanged, the same.
The changing season calls my heart
To praise the God who made each part.
Chorus
In every leaf, I see You, Lord,
In every breeze that moves the fields.
In eagle’s wings above the clouds,
Your glory shines, Your love is real.
In every flower, every tree,
Your hand of grace is clear to me.
Wherever I may turn my eyes,
Your beauty fills the earth and skies.
Bridge
I lift my voice, I lift my hands,
And praise the God who formed this land.
From mountain peaks to blades of grass,
Your fingerprints are where I pass.
The heavens sing, the rivers roar,
Your glory lives forevermore.
Chorus
In every leaf, I see You, Lord,
In every breeze that moves the fields.
In eagle’s wings above the clouds,
Your glory shines, Your love is real.
In every flower, every tree,
Your hand of grace is clear to me.
Wherever I may turn my eyes,
Your beauty fills the earth and skies.
You made the autumn for me to see—
A living portrait of majesty.
